# agentprof

> AI Agent Workspace Optimizer & Shell Latency Profiler

agentprof is a high-performance Rust CLI & TUI tool designed to eliminate subshell startup latency, profile Oh My Zsh plugins, audit AI context bloat (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules), inspect MCP tool schemas, and accelerate AI coding agents like Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, and Grok.

## Installation
- Homebrew: `brew tap dautovri/tap && brew install agentprof`
- Cargo: `cargo install agentprof`
- Repository: https://github.com/dautovri/agentprof
- Live Documentation: https://dautovri.github.io/agentprof/

## Core Features & Commands
- `agentprof scan`: Unified workspace audit (Context + Subshell + MCP + Skills + Secrets).
- `agentprof tui`: Full-screen interactive terminal dashboard.
- `agentprof mcp`: Profiles active Model Context Protocol server tool schemas and token load.
- `agentprof skills`: Audits installed agent skills and detects trigger keyword collisions.
- `agentprof agent`: Profiles OpenCode, Claude Code, and Grok environments.
- `agentprof omz`: Profiles Oh My Zsh plugin startup latency with microsecond accuracy.
- `agentprof bench`: Benchmarks subshell spawn time and computes agent tool latency penalties.
- `agentprof lint`: Detects instruction contradictions and vague rules across agent files.
- `agentprof compress <file>`: Compresses verbose instruction files into dense rule sheets.
- `agentprof wrap "<cmd>"`: Injects subshell fast-path into live agent sessions.
- `agentprof report --markdown`: Generates a 0-100 Workspace Health Score for GitHub PRs.
- `agentprof fix --all`: Injects non-interactive fast-path into ~/.zshrc and creates .claudeignore.
- `agentprof compile`: Compiles monolithic rules into modular JIT instructions.
- `agentprof ci`: Generates a GitHub Actions workflow for PR context budget checks.
